genesis.36.p1.b1.text: This is the account of Esau (that is, Edom).

genesis.36.p1.b2.text: And Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau, Basemath gave birth to Reuel, and Oholibamah gave birth to Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

genesis.36.p1.b3.text: For their possessions were too great for them to dwell together; the land where they stayed could not support them because of their livestock.

genesis.36.p1.b4.text: So Esau (that is, Edom) settled in the area of Mount Seir.

genesis.36.p2.b5.text: These are the chiefs among the sons of Esau.

genesis.36.p2.b6.text: … This is the Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness as he was pasturing the donkeys of his father Zibeon.

genesis.36.p2.b7.text: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who were living in the land …

genesis.36.p2.b8.text: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah daughter of Anah.

genesis.36.p3.b9.text: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the Israelites:

genesis.36.p3.b10.text: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place.

genesis.36.p3.b11.text: … Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab …

genesis.36.p3.b12.text: Esau was the father of the Edomites.
